_comment: Prices that move with the story. See src/core/prices.gd. Named prices are what dialogue charges for one thing; markets scale traders' prices for some goods while their conditions hold.

brig_line._comment: Striking Brigodunon's line from the house of Vettius's book. Cheap while the house is only buying futures; dearer if the house thinks Brigodunon cheated it, refused it or killed its man; ten times dearer once the Aedui take Noviodunum and the forward sale is real; gone at Alesia.

hostages_back._comment: Buying back hostages still held at Noviodunum from the house, for delivery after the harvest on Dannotalos's word. Gone once the Aedui take the depot.

house_debt._comment: Buying the house of Vettius's debt from Demarchos. Ruinous; Theron puts his own purse in if he thinks well enough of the player.

theron_owes._comment: What Theron owes his family for the ship of wine he lost.

markets._comment: Gergovia under siege: food and medicine cost what wine used to.
